description: This file is a PHP template for rendering a project widget in a crowdfunding platform. It dynamically displays project details such as status tags, image, category, author, description, investment info, and rewards, incorporating logic to handle different project states and user investments.

classes.name: Image
classes.description: Represents an image associated with a project, providing methods to get links for different sizes.

methods.name: getLink
methods.description: Method of the Image class that returns the URL link for the image with specified dimensions.

methods.description: Method for retrieving localized text strings based on keys.

methods.description: Method that truncates text to a specified length.
